EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE WELIVITIYA - DIVITHURAPRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONSORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of return member of Welivitiya - Divithura Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason ofResignation ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the United National Party, the recognized political party to which BandarigodageGotabhaya the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66 A (1) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decide uponreturned member of United National Party who belongs to such party and is not disqualified under Section 9 of the LocalAuthorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision tonominate Yakgaha Hewage Ajith Induka to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE, I, Kanda Uda Chandralal, Returning Officer of the Welivitiya - Divithura PradeshiyaSabha, acting in terms of Section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declarethat Yakgaha Hewage Ajith Induka was selected as the member of the Welivitiya - Divithura Pradeshiya Sabha.
K. U. CHANDRALAL,Returning Officer,Welivitiya - Divithura Pradeshiya Sabha.District Election Office,Galle,28th June, 2019.
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
